speaker: richard_burbage
text: Seven yards. Peach-coloured velvet, in grain. I have said it, and I will say it until it is written.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have heard seven yards. I have not heard a week in which the stock can buy them.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The stock has just taken a part. Let the part look like a king.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The part has a Thursday already, and a gown still open. Velvet waits.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wait until the autumn. A Lent stage does not need a new peach.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Peach. I should look very well in seven yards, and I am not the one asking.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You are never the one asking. You are the one standing next to the ask.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It is not for thee. It is for a king who must be seen at the back of a yard. Seven yards, in grain, or he looks like a blanket.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Timber, before peach. I have said timber once today. I can say it twice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Father. The velvet is not the lease.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And it is not today. Autumn, when a yard is paying. We will talk of seven yards then. No price this morning. No man's name from Cheapside.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No price. I have been equally wronged once already. I do not need a draper's bill for dinner.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Autumn is a word the stock can keep. Peach can wait in the mouth until then.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Write it, John. Seven yards. Peach. Autumn. Then he cannot say we forgot.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will write that he asked, and that he waits. I will not write a sum.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou might want the king to shine, Will. Thou art very patient with other men's cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I want him to shine when there is a yard to shine at. Seven yards on an empty gallery is a blanket with a better name.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two mottoes, then. Equally wronged, and not before autumn. The door will be crowded.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Easter Monday the house opens. Velvet does not open it. A sound stage does.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Autumn. The bag is counted. Do not spend it a second time in the same hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not spending it. My part goes on a horse when I hire one. Not on a yard of peach.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the velvet is Dick's waiting, and the horse is yours, and the stock is John's, and I was first on the paper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Autumn. I shall ask again when the leaves are dirty. I remember cloth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Ask then. Not before.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Seven yards, and no figure beside them. I can sing that. I will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done with peach. The cloth on the table is the only cloth that was paid for today.
